sentences.text: By way of the present petitions under Article 227 of the Constitution of India, the petitioners have challenged the judgment and order dated 28.03.2023 and 06.04.2023, passed by 4th Additional District Judge, Panchmahal at Halol, in several miscellaneous applications filed by the original NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/8169/2023 ORDER DATED: 20/07/2023 undefined claimants - respondents herein under Section 10(5) of the Petroleum and Minerals Pipeline (Acquisition of Right of User in Land) Act, 1962, by which the amount awarded towards compensation for laying petroleum pipeline came to be increased, mainly on two grounds that the learned Additional District Judge has allowed the applications without leading any evidence and the award has been passed in absence of the advocate who was instructed to appear before the Trial Court on behalf of the present petitioner company.

entities.text: 4th Additional District Judge, Panchmahal at Halol
entities.label: COURT

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. In response to notice issued by this Court, learned advocate Mr.Mohmedsaif Hakim has appeared for respondents in all matters.
It appears that in many matters, some of the original claimants have passed away.

However, Mr.Hakim has submitted that he will file appropriate application before the Trial Court for bringing legal heirs of those persons who have passed away during the proceedings, if Ihb Limited vs Pateliya Mangalsinh Javrabhai Bin ...

4. Learned Senior Advocate Mr.M.R.Bhatt

with learned advocate Mr.Munjaal Bhatt appearing for the petitioner would submit that the matters are required to be remanded to consider them afresh since the same have been decided in absence of any material produced by either of the parties.
He would submit that unfortunately the advocate engaged by the present petitioner company did not remain present before the Trial Court and therefore ex-parte order has been passed.
He therefore submits that appropriate orders may be passed.

5. On the other hand, Mr.Hakim, learned advocate appearing for the respondents would submit that if the matters are remanded, the original applicants may also be given proper opportunity to bring additional evidence before the Trial Court.

6. Considering the above submissions and the orders impugned in these petitions, we pass the following order :
(i) The petitions are allowed.
Rule is made absolute in each petition.
NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/8169/2023 ORDER DATED: 20/07/2023 undefined (ii)

In each petition, the impugned judgment and order dated 28.03.2023 and 06.04.2023 passed by the Additional District Judge, Panchmahal at Halol, in respective miscellaneous applications are hereby quashed and set aside.

entities.text: Additional District Judge, Panchmahal at Halol
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: (iii) The matters are remanded to 4th Additional District Judge, Panchmahal at Halol.

entities.text: 4th Additional District Judge, Panchmahal at Halol
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: (iv) Civil Misc. Application (DC) No.12 of 2022 and allied matters which have been disposed of by judgment and orders dated 28.03.2023 and 06.04.2023 are hereby revived.
(v) The original claimants - private respondents herein are permitted to lead evidence by examining witness or producing documents.
The petitioner company and Respondent No.2 i.e. Competent Officer are also permitted to file reply and produce additional documents.
The Trial Court shall decide the aforesaid applications in accordance with law, as early as possible and preferably within a period of six months.

NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/8169/2023 ORDER DATED: 20/07/2023 undefined (vi) As per request made by Mr.Hakim, it would be open for the legal heirs to file application for joining party before the Trial Court.
(vii) The amount which has been deposited before this Court shall be returned to the petitioner.
